Under Danish rules, what is the longest permitted measurement period for a personal dosimeter for a worker expected to receive more than 6 mSv per year from external radiation in planned situations, and for one expected to receive between 1 and 6 mSv?

Under Danish rules on dose limits for occupational exposure (not special occupational exposure), in what circumstances may the Danish Health Authority approve that a radiation worker receives up to 50 mSv effective dose in one year?

According to the IAEA transport regulations, what monitoring is required for occupational exposure from transport activities if the effective dose is likely to be between 1 and 6 mSv in a year, and what if it is likely to exceed 6 mSv?

Hvordan adskiller kravet til individuel dosisovervågning af arbejdstagere ved transport sig mellem IAEA's transportregler og dansk lovgivning, når den forventede effektive dosis er mellem 1 og 6 mSv pr. år?
Fastsætter de danske regler en maksimal brugstid i år for en lukket radioaktiv kilde, og hvad siger de om kildens anvendelsesperiode?

En virksomhed har en lukket Cs-137-kilde på 0,5 TBq. Hvilken sikringsgruppe hører kilden til, hvor lang tid må der højst gå mellem eftersyn og radiologisk kontrol, og hvilke krav til tekniske barrierer og til kontrol af besiddelsen gælder?

En klinik får udført både statuskontrol og konstanskontrol af sine røntgenapparater. Hvor meget dokumentation for hver af de to slags kontrol skal klinikken bevare, hvad skal den indeholde, og hvem skal indberette fejl ved statuskontrollen til Sundhedsstyrelsen og hvornår?

According to the IAEA safety standards, which decommissioning strategy is preferred, what must the licensee demonstrate for the strategy it selects, and what happens to the strategy if the shutdown of a facility is sudden?

According to the IAEA safety standards, for how long should pregnancy be avoided after radiopharmaceutical therapy with 131I iodide for thyroid cancer, with 89Sr chloride for bone metastases, and with 90Y colloid for arthritic joints?

According to the IAEA safety standards, when an organization outsources work or buys in items and services that may influence safety, where does responsibility for safety lie, and what capability must the organization keep for itself regarding what is supplied?

According to the IAEA safety standards, what conditions apply to the people or units assigned to carry out independent assessments of an organization's management system, and may they come from outside the organization?

According to the IAEA safety standards, under which conditions is it enough to inform the regulatory body of an intended practice without applying for an authorization, and what features make a practice suitable for registration rather than a licence?

According to the IAEA safety standards, what are the principal approaches to the predisposal management of radioactive waste, which of them is the preferred option, and under what condition is releasing waste to the environment so that it spreads out acceptable?

According to IAEA publications on near surface disposal of radioactive waste, which dose or risk constraint applies to members of the public after closure for the expected gradual evolution of the facility, does that constraint apply when judging future people accidentally digging into the waste, and which reference doses are cited for that case instead?

According to IAEA guidance on authorized discharges, over what period is compliance with discharge limits normally shown, why do some regulators add shorter-term limits, and what general example values (not those of one particular country) are given for a calendar-quarter limit and for an instantaneous release-rate limit relative to the annual figures?

According to IAEA nuclear security guidance, an adversary is rated on a 1-5 scale as 4 for capability, 2 for intention and 3 for financial resources. What overall threat rating do the highest-rating, average-rating and lowest-rating methods give, and what assumption about the adversary lies behind the highest and the lowest method?

A radiography company sends one of its gamma exposure devices, loaded with an Ir-192 source of about 3.7 TBq, by road to a work site in another country, using the device itself as the transport package. The package design certificates have already been submitted to all countries concerned for earlier shipments. Under the IAEA safety standards, what kind of transport package do such devices usually qualify as, and must the consignor notify the competent authorities before this particular shipment? Explain the activity threshold that decides it.

A university research group holds sealed sources, unsealed radionuclides and a mobile X ray unit. Under the IAEA Basic Safety Standards, what must its inventory of these sources record, and what does the IAEA safety guide for research and education recommend that users write down when they take a source out of storage, and how often should those records be audited?

En hudlæge vil behandle en patient for basalcellekarcinom (en form for hudkræft) med et røntgenapparat, der arbejder ved 50 kV. Hvordan skal behandlingen klassificeres efter danske regler, hvilke krav gælder for personalet før hver fraktion, og må andre personer end patienten opholde sig i behandlingsrummet under bestrålingen?

Et røntgenapparat til industriel radiografi har en maksimal rørspænding på 180 kV. Hvor stor må dosishastigheden fra apparatet højst være med lukket strålevindue, og hvor meget egenfiltrering skal det have efter danske regler? Er der en undtagelse fra filtreringskravet, og hvad kræves, hvis apparatets egenfiltrering er meget lav?

Under Danish rules, a hospital sends patients home after giving them a radiopharmaceutical. What dose constraint governs sending them home, what information must the patients receive (and does it differ between diagnostic and therapeutic administrations), and how may the hospital document the radioactive material these patients discharge?

En virksomhed skal røntgenfotografere svejsninger på en stor rørledning på en byggeplads med en lukket Se-75-kilde på 3 TBq, fordi emnet ikke kan bringes ind i et anlæg. Hvor mange arbejdstagere skal efter danske regler være til stede og med hvilke kvalifikationer, hvilke krav gælder for længden af kablet til betjeningen, og hvornår må man undvære en kollimator?

En ekstern servicevirksomhed udfører modtagekontrol af en ny CT-skanner på et hospital, der har tilladelse til medicinsk anvendelse, og finder en fejl, der kan føre til utilsigtet bestråling. Hvem skal efter danske regler indberette fejlen til Sundhedsstyrelsen og hvornår, hvad skal være på plads, før skanneren tages i brug, og hvor længe skal dokumentationen bevares? Er der tilfælde, hvor Sundhedsstyrelsen ikke behøver indberetningen?

Under Danish rules, a contractor sends one of its own radiation workers to work at a hospital in a task that requires the worker to be classified in category A. What must the hospital have received before the worker may start, from whom, and how many years must the dose information cover? Who classifies the worker, and what must the hospital check about that classification?

Under Danish rules, which category must a radiation worker be placed in if they are expected to receive exactly 6 mSv effective dose per year and no equivalent dose to the lens of the eye, skin or extremities above the limits for category A or B?
Under Danish rules, a package has a dose rate of 0.05 mSv/h at 1 metre from its surface. What is its transport index (TI), and how is TI defined?

Efter de danske regler om dosisgrænser for erhvervsmæssig bestråling (ikke særlig erhvervsmæssig bestråling): under hvilke omstændigheder kan Sundhedsstyrelsen godkende, at en stråleudsat arbejdstager modtager op til 50 mSv effektiv dosis i ét år?
